CustomField.description: Displays the animal's primary image directly on the record page for fast visual identification by welfare staff.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISBLANK(Primary_Image_URL__c), "No profile image", IMAGE(Primary_Image_URL__c, Display_Name__c, 220, 220) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Shows the image from Primary Image URL when one is available.
CustomField.label: Profile Image
